difficulty_reason: The author transforms first-order intuitionistic proofs with equivalence and compatibility theories into proofs using equality-like introduction rules. The forward construction canonically identifies eigenvariables by the least equivalence generated by hypotheses and transports synthetic inferences to representative sequents; the reverse construction uses structural compatibility and cuts before cut elimination. The equality-free, constructor-free signature and typing-redundancy conditions are essential to this proof-system transformation. The two directions are one counted equivalence; compatibility and basic logical facts remain supporting context.
